policy: Generated questions use original wording and solutions to standard mathematical problems. Official archive material is linked rather than republished. Titles and year labels follow the institutions; no affiliation is implied.

archives.title: CMI undergraduate entrance: syllabus and past papers
archives.notes: Official page lists undergraduate papers through 2025 and describes mostly Class 12 material, objective questions, and longer problems. Its postgraduate entries must not be mixed into the undergraduate bank.

archives.title: ISI B.Stat. syllabus and sample questions
archives.notes: Retain the publisher's label Sample Questions. UGA and UGB resources are separate. Archive lists 2026 and 2015–2024; do not invent a 2025 entry.

archives.title: HBCSE RMO, INMO and IOQM past papers
archives.publisher: Homi Bhabha Centre for Science Education, TIFR
archives.notes: Official mathematics archive includes papers and solutions. It explicitly notes that published solutions are not the only possible valid solutions.

papers.title: CMI BSc entrance 2025
papers.notes: 17 Part A items carry 40 points; six Part B problems carry 80 points. Correct reasoning is required in Part B. The linked solution document labels itself draft.

papers.title: ISI UGB 2026 sample questions
papers.notes: Each question is marked 10 points in this document.

papers.title: RMO 2025 — Non-KV, Non-JNV paper
papers.notes: The exam paper requires justification and assigns equal marks to all six questions.
